scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Hello stranger.
I wish I could
offer you help
on your adventures...

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
We can't even begin
to fathom the number
of markets and people
out there in this wide,
wide world of ours.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
I believe it's time
for my final lecture.
I'll discuss the definitive
skill of the Merchant: ^871F78Vending^000000. Please listen carefully.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
So...
How much have
you learned
about Vending?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Now to talk about
^871F78Push Cart^000000. First off, you need to know Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can even learn the Push Cart skill.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
So, have you
learned Push Cart up
to Level 4 like I asked?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Ah, ready to
learn already,
are you? Alright,
let me tell you
about ^871F78Over Charge^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
So...
How is it going
with learning that
^871F78Over Charge^000000 skill?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Let me see those
Red Potions. Now,
how much did you
pay for these...?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Let me see those
Red Potions. Ah, it seems you researched the market and bought the cheapest ones! Great work!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Hmm...
You'll find some NPCs
selling 10 Red Potions
in Prontera. Your task
is to buy the potions
for the cheapest price.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Alright...
I've given it some thought and I've come up with a little challenge for you. Bring me... 10 Red Potions!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Ah, you're back!
Now, I was going
to tell you about
the Discount skill, right?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: So, how is it going with learning the Discount skill? Like I always say, if you can't make a bargain, you can't be a Merchant!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ah, you've come back to learn more. Let's see, what was I going to tell you about... Right, Mammonite!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
So...
Did you learn the
Increase Weight Limit
skill up to Level 4
like I asked?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: You've just started out as a Merchant, haven't you? How would you like to learn the fundamentals of business from an experienced colleague?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: However, what I have to teach would only benefit Merchants. Trading and money making are my areas of expertise. If you have any Merchant friends, send them to me.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Technically, yes, you're a Merchant, but I know an expert when I see one. You've been through the Merchant life before, I can tell!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
All of them are possible customers and business partners. Of course, it'll be up to you to meet them.
If you can be sincerely kind to everyone that you meet, you'll
have no problem.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: The Vending skill is an active skill which allows you to open your own shop where you stand. Vending allows you to do real business with other people.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
However, you can only vend items that are stored in your PushCart,
so you'll need one of those. The maximum price you can set for
each item is 99,990,000 Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Basically, you've got to learn the Push Cart skill first before you can learn the Vending skill.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: The higher the level of the Vending skill, the more items you can vend at one time. Vending is mastered at Skill Level 10.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Level 1 Vending allows you
to vend a total of 3 items at one time. Each time you level up the Vending skill, the total number of items you can vend will
increase by one.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: But it looks like I just put my foot in my mouth. I'm sorry, I didn't notice that you already mastered the Vending skill...

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: For your final assignment, I will ask you to learn the Vending skill up to Skill Level 4. Of course, once you do, I'll give you a little reward. I'll be waiting, so do your best~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: But I see that you must already know that, huh? Well, seeing as you're so clever, I think you've earned this little prize~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
You're such an
excellent student!
Please, take this
little reward for
all your efforts~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Hmm...
Haven't learned Level 4 Vending yet, huh? Just keep in mind that being able to vend things is one
of the defining characteristics of being a Merchant!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Excellent!
You've taught yourself well. Here, you've earned this little reward~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Oh, I see that you're very serious about being a Merchant. I'm proud that you've managed to master this skill! Here, you deserve this reward!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ah, now you have mastered the fundamentals of the Merchant class. Just keep practicing the basic principles, like researching the market for item prices, and you should be fine.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Although everything we do is for money, never forget customer needs and always sell your products at a suitably fair price. Otherwise, no one may buy your goods!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Well, there's nothing more I can teach you for now. Go out into the world and make your mark as a Merchant.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
And feel free to
visit me whenever
the mood strikes you.
Good luck to you~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Push Cart can be mastered at
Skill Level 10. This skill allows you to carry a Push Cart with you. You can carry a maximum of 100 different kinds of items that weigh less than 8,000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: As you can see, this skill is an advanced form of the Increase Weight Limit skill. You can procure a PushCart from most Kafra Ladies for a certain fee.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Once you have rented a Cart, you can hold on to it so long as you don't take it off. The disadvantage to using a PushCart is that your movement speed is reduced to
almost half! Horrible, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Fortunately, when you increase
the level of the Push Cart skill, your movement speed will slowly be restored. With Push Cart Level 10, a PushCart won't slow you
down at all!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
For now, why don't
you learn the Push Cart
skill up to Level 4? Once
you do that, I can go on to
my next lecture.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Ah, and I see that you've been focusing on learning Push Cart. Although you might still have a problem with your movement
speed, it shouldn't be a big deal.
Well done~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Wonderful! You've already
mastered the Push Cart skill.
You truly deserve a little bit of a reward~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Still not there, huh?
Well, remember that you need
Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can learn the Push
Cart skill. I hope that helps.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Well done~
You've been a very
cooperative student.
You deserve a little
reward for your effort~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Excellent!
You've actually went above and beyond mastered the Push Cart skill. Great work!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Next time, I'll talk about the skill that sets Merchants apart from all the other classes: ^871F78Vending^000000. So don't miss it!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Like Discount, Over Charge is a Passive skill that can be mastered at Skill Level 10. Therefore, it doesn't require SP to use it.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Over Charge allows you to sell items to NPC shops for more Zeny. The higher your Over Charge Skill Level, the more Zeny you'll receive for items sold to NPCs.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Personally, I think you should learn this skill for sure! For your next assignment, learn Over Charge up to Level 4. It shouldn't be too difficult to do.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ah, you've already learned Level 4 Over Charge. Perfect! Let me give you a little reward~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Amazing! You've already mastered the Over Charge skill! You must have wanted this reward badly~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Once you do that,
we can talk about
more advanced stuff.
Do your best~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Mm? You haven't
learned Over Charge
up to Skill Level 4 yet?
There's no rush, but I won't be able to lecture on anything until you finish this little task.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Nice work!
I can tell that
you've done just
as I asked. Please,
take this little reward~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Whoa...
You actually
mastered Over Charge?
Most impressive! You deserve a small reward for your work!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Next time, I'll discuss the
Push Cart skill. Be ready for this lecture, as Push Cart is one of the more important skills for a Merchant.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Ah...!
It looks like...
You were scammed!
D-don't worry, though,
I won't tell anybody.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Oh well, it happens even to the best of us. Just think of this as an invaluable learning experience.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Now, why don't you go to Prontera and try to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC for the cheapest price again?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Alright, next time, we'll talk about the skill that you can learn after knowing how to Discount:
^871F78Over Charge^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: First, you'll probably want to research the market price for Red Potions. And always, be careful of scammers and cheats!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: It's not too hard, but the stipulation I'm adding is that you've got to find the merchant selling Red Potions for the cheapest price.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: So first, you'll need to research the market price for Red Potions. Also, be careful of scammers! If the price is too good to be true, it usually is.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ha ha ha, let me make your goal a bit less confusing. You will need to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Prontera's a bit far from here, isn't it? I'll just use this Kafra Warp-- Mahnsoo has a bunch for
some reason --to send you there right now. Get ready...!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: The ^871F78Discount^000000 skill allows you to buy items at lower prices from NPC shops. It is a ^871F78Passive Skill^000000 which is always in effect and does not consume SP.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
The Discount skill is
mastered at ^871F78Level 10^000000. The higher the skill level, the less you have to pay for items at NPC shops.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Alright! Now, in order to become closer towards becoming a true Merchant, I want you to learn the Discount skill up to Level 4.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Oooh, good work.
I see that you've
raised your Discount
to Level 4 already.
Here, take this
small reward~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
It'd be nicer if you could
master it, but you might be more interested in devoting your time to other skills.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Still, you can't ignore the fact that bargaining is an essential skill for a Merchant! Come back to me when you're ready~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Not yet, huh?
Well, you should be able to reach that goal soon. After all, it's one of the basics of being a Merchant!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Ah, you've learned
how to use the Discount skill
well enough. Good, here's a little reward for your hard work~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Alright, my next lesson will hopefully offer you a bit more of a challenge. Come back when you think you're ready, alright?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: ^871F78Mammonite^000000 is a skill that lets you greatly damage targets with Zeny. Money really is power!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: The upside is that it inflicts great damage and only uses a little SP. However, the downside is that it will also consume your Zeny!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: So if you use this skill too often, you might end up bankrupt! So be really careful. Also, as the Skill Level for Mammonite increases, so does the attack strength and Zeny consumption.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ah, I see that you've already tried this skill. How much money have you wasted using Mammonite? Not too much, I hope.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Well, since you're still green, I feel awfully sorry if you've wasted Zeny. Why don't you take this as compensation?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Ah. I can tell that you have. Not bad! By now you should be able to learn the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill, but I'll teach you about that later.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
No? That's fine.
But I can't teach you
much more if you can't grasp these simple basics, so hurry and learn those skills, okay?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000

Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
Sure!
I'll make it on my own!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
{0}
But first things first!
You better learn the
^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: You can't really be a Merchant if you can't even carry around goods to sell. As you increase the level of this skill, you can carry around more items.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Why don't you upgrade your
Increase Weight Limit skill up to Level 4? After that, we can talk more about becoming a true Merchant.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Great...!
Ah, and I see that you've learned the ^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill to at least Level 4. You're a real go-getter, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Since your Increase Weight
Limit skill level is high enough, you must be able to see a new skill in your Skill Window: ^871F78Discount^000000!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: But we'll discuss the Discount skill later. There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous study.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
Oh...
And I'll tell you
more about the Discount
skill later. I always manage
to forget about that!

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text:
On your own?
Hahaha, that's the spirit!
But still, the advice I'm giving is free. It couldn't hurt to give what I say a little bit of thought.

scripts.speaker: Guarnien
scripts.text: Well, if you ever change your mind, stop by and talk to me anytime. And as a Merchant, you should know that free advice is the best!

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...

It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text: You know, the name of the company that has all those beautiful ladies working for it. Ka... Ka-something. Anyway, I hear they're concerned about their growing competition.

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
It's none of my business, but it's good to know what's going on in
the world, particularly if it'll affect the markets.

Hello, hello~
Why don't you buy
some Red Potions?
They're essential for travel, and these Red Potions are the best for newer adventurers~

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text: I will sell you 10 Red Potions for ^871F78{0} zeny^000000. You'd better get them now while they're still here!
Buy
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
Excellent!
You certainly have an eye for bargains. Here you go, 10 Red Potions fresh from the... Potioner...

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
Whoa, hold on!
You can't afford
these potions...
Please come back
when you have enough
Zeny, alright?

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
Whoa, hold on!
There's no way you carry all of this! Why don't you put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage before coming back?

scripts.speaker: Sagle
scripts.text:
Alright...
But don't
complain if
these potions
are sold out!

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.

Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text: It's probably not even a reliable rumor, but I've heard that members of the royal family have been dying from some unknown cause.

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
Huh.
Now that's some morbid news!
Well, hopefully, there's no truth to it whatsoever. None at all...

I'm selling sets of
10 Red Potions for {0} Zeny.
Would you like some?
Buy
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
Good choice~
Thank you for
using my shop.

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
Ooops!
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I've got to stay in business somehow, you know?

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
...Huh?
You better put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage, you can't carry much else!

scripts.speaker: Kellion
scripts.text:
Well, I'm sorry
to hear that. But
I guess I'll see
you later.

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text: It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text: However, money can be much more dependable than some people I know. You can rely on money more than anything else in this world.

Welcome to my shop.
I'm just a young girl who's a victim of circumstance, forced to sell potions on the street for dirt cheap prices.

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text:
Would you like
to buy 10 Red Potions
for {0} Zeny, kind adventurer?
Buy
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text:
Thank you so much.
Now I can finally
afford food again...

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text:
Wait, wait!
I am sorry, but you don't have enough money. Would you please get some more Zeny before coming back?

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text:
Wait, wait!
You can't possibly carry any more items. Why don't you put your things in Kafra Storage first?

scripts.speaker: Aigie
scripts.text:
I understand.
But I hope you
see that I'm offering
you a really good price.
^666666*Sniff Sniff*^000000

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
The Schwarzwald Republic...
It's a really interesting country. There's Juno and a few other places worth looking around.

The Schwarzwald Republic...
It's a really interesting country. There's Juno and a few other places worth looking around.

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
They may not be the best places
for sight seeing, but I'm sure they'll offer something of interest to you adventurers.
If you've checked out the market for Red Potions, you know that my price is the best. I'm offering 10 Red Potions for only {0} Zeny!
Buy
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
Heh heh...!
It looks like
you know your
stuff. You're a
Merchant yourself,
aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
But sorry buddy.
Rules are rules.
You gotta meet my price
if you want these potions.

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
But sorry buddy. I can't let you carry more than you can handle.
You ought to free up some of your inventory space when you get the chance.

scripts.speaker: Jayon
scripts.text:
Just looking
around, eh?
I understand.
But you better take
advantage of a real
deal when you see one!

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text: I see too many people struggling to scrape every penny and put it all into their savings...
I see too many people struggling to scrape every penny and put it all into their savings...

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text: Now, don't get me wrong. It's a good idea to invest in the future. But money exists to be spent! Enjoy every moment, that's what I say~

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text:
Besides...
You can't take
your money with you
when your time's up,
you know?

Don't say anything.
I know what you want.
10 Red Potions, right?
I'll sell them to you
for the low price of {0} Zeny~
Buy
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text:
Excellent choice!
Good products at affordable prices! That's my ethic as a merchant.

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text: Ooh, but you don't even have enough Zeny to purchase these potions. I'm sorry, but I can't sell these just to lose money, you know?

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text: Ooh, but it doesn't look like you've got enough inventory space to carry any more items.

scripts.speaker: Maos
scripts.text: Well, I can't force you to buy these, but I'm telling you that you're passing up a real bargain!
